scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.test: npm run build --prefix apps/api && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix apps/api && npm ci --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
